issue.title: Verify & harden per-user project list & My Work filtering
issue.body:
> **Scope note:** This ticket is **verification/validation only, NOT a rewrite**. The My Work tab (`MyWorkTab.tsx`) and `mergeUserChapterAssignments.ts` (+ their tests) were authored by @mattrace-gloo and are already shipped; this work is **largely satisfied alongside #31**. Remaining scope is limited to **verifying filtering correctness against the existing tests** and adding edge-case coverage. Assigned to @mattrace-gloo.

### Current state on main

- `src/app/tabs/MyWorkTab.tsx` (+ `MyWorkTab.test.tsx`) — the My Work screen, already shipped.
- `src/hooks/useMyWorkChapters.ts` — loads via `getMyWorkChapters(userId)` using `parseUserId()` (`:15`).
- `src/db/queries.ts:getMyWorkChapters` (`:305`) filters `WHERE ca.assigned_user_id = ?` and excludes complete chapters (`.filter(row => !isCompleteStatus(row.status))`, `:343`).
- `src/services/mergeUserChapterAssignments.ts` (+ `mergeUserChapterAssignments.test.ts`) — merges assigned + peer-check lists, keeping the higher-priority status (`peer_check > draft > not_started`).
- Per-user project list: `getProjectsWithSummary(userId)` joins `user_projects` (`queries.ts:61`).

### Problems / why

- The recording aggregates inside these queries are **broken** by the `r.chapter_assignment_id = ca.id` join (`queries.ts:66,284,334`) — the column doesn't exist (fixed in #98). My Work counts/sync state are therefore wrong until that lands.
- `getMyWorkChapters` performs no-index scan on `assigned_user_id` until #103 adds `idx_ca_assigned_user`.
- Filtering correctness (assigned vs peer-check, complete exclusion, multi-account isolation) needs explicit verification against the existing tests + new cases.

### Target design

- Confirm My Work shows exactly the active user's assigned + peer-check chapters, excludes complete, and isolates across accounts (active user via `parseUserId`/`storage.getActiveUserId`).
- Ensure aggregates are correct after #98 and indexed after #103.
- Strengthen the existing test suites (`MyWorkTab.test.tsx`, `mergeUserChapterAssignments.test.ts`) with edge cases: a chapter assigned to user A and peer-checked by user B; duplicate assignment across payloads; complete-status exclusion; empty state.

### Implementation steps

1. Audit `getMyWorkChapters` + `useMyWorkChapters` + `mergeUserChapterAssignments` for correctness against the active-user contract.
2. Depend on #98 (join fix) and #103 (index) for correct/fast aggregates; re-verify after they land.
3. Add/extend tests in `MyWorkTab.test.tsx` and `mergeUserChapterAssignments.test.ts` for the edge cases above.
4. Confirm per-user project list (`getProjectsWithSummary`) scopes strictly by `user_projects.user_id`.
5. Fix any filtering defects uncovered (e.g. status-priority gaps, complete-exclusion off-by-one).

### Acceptance criteria (verify-only)

- [ ] **Verify** My Work lists only the active user's non-complete assigned + peer-check chapters; multi-account isolation confirmed against existing tests.
- [ ] **Verify** recording counts/sync state are correct after the #98 join fix.
- [ ] **Verify** project list is scoped strictly by `user_projects`.
- [ ] Existing tests pass; extend with the edge cases above only where a gap is found (no rewrite of the shipped feature).

### Test plan / verification

```bash
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

- Tests default `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9999` via `jest.env.cjs`; **no live API required** — local SQLite/mocked DB.
- Cite/extend `src/app/tabs/MyWorkTab.test.tsx` and `src/services/mergeUserChapterAssignments.test.ts`.
- Do **not** use `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`.

### Out of scope

- Schema FK/index migration (#103), recordings join fix (#98), attribution (#105).

### Links

- Epic: #118
- Related: #31 (My Work tab), #98 (join fix), #103 (index)

comments.body: Note: My Work currently depends on `getMyWorkChapters`, whose recordings join is broken — see #121. Verify/harden after #121 is fixed.
